name: agent-audit-consulting
icp: Berlin Early AI-dopters (2026-06-17 attendees) with >=1 agent in some running state (prototype or prod)

offer.paragraph: Done-for-you audit of your AI-agent setup. We review your prompts, your tool wiring, and your audit logs; produce a written report naming every place an agent could hallucinate without you catching it; pre-register the failure modes you should be grepping for.
offer.promise: If we find zero auditable risks in your current setup, the audit is free.
